newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds and Reynolds files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds and Reynolds files for offering.

text.p: Reynolds and Reynolds Co said Friday that it filed a preliminary registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public debt offering.
The issue, which may take the form of notes, debentures or other unsecured evidences of indebtedness, would not exceed $300 million, the company said.
Reynolds said it plans to use the funds from the offering to refinance debt incurred with the acquisition of Duplex Products Inc, and for general corporate purposes.

"Given the favorable interest rate environment and our growth profile, this seemed an appropriate time for us to take advantage of the public debt market," Reynolds Chairman, President and Chief Executive, David Holmes said in a statement.
Reynolds and Reynolds, a Dayton, Ohio-based provider of integrated information management systems and related services, reported fiscal 1996 revenues of $1.1 billion.
